tooltip.randomthings.online_detector: Outputs redstone signal when the configured player is online
tooltip.randomthings.redstone_observer: Mirrors the redstone output of a remote target block. Use a Redstone Tool to link it to its target.
tooltip.randomthings.biome_radar: Build an iron-bars antenna above it, insert a Biome Crystal, apply redstone to scan. Right-click with paper to extract a Position Filter when found.
tooltip.randomthings.basic_redstone_inte: Transmits redstone signals to a paired Basic Redstone Interface. Use a Redstone Tool to link the pair.
tooltip.randomthings.entity_detector: Emits a redstone signal when matching entities are in range. Configurable filter and range.
tooltip.randomthings.item_collector: Collects nearby item entities and pushes them into the inventory behind it. Place against the side of an inventory.
tooltip.randomthings.advanced_item_colle: Like the Item Collector but with a configurable per-axis range and a slot for an Item Filter.
tooltip.randomthings.inventory_rerouter: Forwards an attached inventory through its other 5 faces. Right-click a face to cycle which side of the target inventory that face exposes.
tooltip.randomthings.dyeing_machine: Combines an item with a dye to produce a dyed result. Recipes are datapack-driven.
tooltip.randomthings.imbuing_station: Combines three ingredients with a central item to produce an imbued result. Recipes are datapack-driven.
tooltip.randomthings.redstone_tool: Right-click a Redstone Observer, then right-click the block you want it to mirror.
message.randomthings.redstone_tool.linki: Linking from %s, %s, %s — right-click the target block
tooltip.randomthings.ancient_brick: Part of the Ancient Furnace structure. Right-click the top with a Nether Star to activate.
tooltip.randomthings.ancient_furnace: The core of an Ancient Furnace. Transforms cold biomes into warmer ones when activated.
tooltip.randomthings.rainbow_lamp: Changes color based on redstone signal
tooltip.randomthings.block_of_sticks_ret: Returns to nearest player after 10 seconds
tooltip.randomthings.biome_stone: The color of these stone variants changes depending on the biome they are in
tooltip.randomthings.biome_glass: Translucent glass that changes color based on the biome
tooltip.randomthings.lapis_glass: Solid for players, but other entities pass through
tooltip.randomthings.quartz_glass: Not solid for players, but solid for other entities
tooltip.randomthings.trigger_glass: Loses its collision box for 3 seconds when powered by redstone. Any trigger glass connected to one receiving the redstone signal will also trigger.
tooltip.randomthings.quartz_lamp: Emits invisible light (level 15) that prevents mob spawning but is not visually apparent
tooltip.randomthings.lapis_lamp: The Lapis Lamp acts like a normal redstone lamp in that it emits a light level of 15. However the light of this lamp does not prevent anything that requires darkness (e.g. Mob Spawning).
tooltip.randomthings.pitcher_plant: The Pitcher Plant is a plant that acts like an infinite water source. Right click it with a fluid container to fill it with water. It also slowly fills cauldrons or other fluid tanks next to it with water.
tooltip.randomthings.glowing_mushroom: Can be found in caves, glows in the dark, and can be used to craft Luminous Powder
tooltip.randomthings.bean: Beans can be found in the wild and can also be re-planted on dirt / grass
tooltip.randomthings.beanstew: A food item that restores 8 hunger points
tooltip.randomthings.weather_egg_sun: When thrown it will spawn a small cloud that will start to slowly go upwards. Once it reaches the sky it will change the weather to sunny.
tooltip.randomthings.weather_egg_rain: When thrown it will spawn a small cloud that will start to slowly go upwards. Once it reaches the sky it will change the weather to rain.
tooltip.randomthings.weather_egg_storm: When thrown it will spawn a small cloud that will start to slowly go upwards. Once it reaches the sky it will change the weather to a thunderstorm.
tooltip.randomthings.evil_tear: Right-click an End Rod (on top of a valid structure) to create an Artificial End Portal
tooltip.randomthings.beanpod: The Bean Pod found on top of a grown Magic Bean. It contains beans, iron, gold, diamonds and emeralds
tooltip.randomthings.lesserbean: If planted a lesser magic bean creates a bean stalk that grows until it hits a block. Climbing that Bean Stalk is faster than a Vanilla ladder
tooltip.randomthings.magicbean: If planted a magic bean creates a bean stalk that grows until it hits the top of the world. On top of it you will find a bean pod which contains valuables
tooltip.randomthings.naturecore: Nature Core spreads life to surrounding area, turning sand to grass and helping plants grow
tooltip.randomthings.biome_crystal: You find Biome Crystals in dungeon chests, they can be used to craft biome blocks
tooltip.randomthings.block_breaker: Breaks blocks in front of it and puts drops in inventories behind it. Can be controlled with redstone.
tooltip.randomthings.block_destabilizer: Makes connected blocks fall when powered by redstone. Has configurable lazy and fuzzy modes.
tooltip.randomthings.sound_dampener: Dampens sounds from Sound Patterns in its inventory within a 20-block radius.
tooltip.randomthings.sound_box: Plays the sound stored on its inserted Sound Pattern when triggered by a redstone pulse. Right-click with a Sound Pattern to insert; right-click again to eject.
tooltip.randomthings.colored_grass: A grass block with a custom color. Right-click with any dye to change its color. Spreads to dirt and decays in low light like normal grass.
tooltip.randomthings.sound_pattern: Records a sound effect. Shift+right-click to clear. Used with Sound Dampeners.
tooltip.randomthings.sound_recorder: Records sounds and saves them to Sound Patterns. Shift+right-click to start/stop recording (max 10 sounds). Right-click to open GUI and save sounds.
tooltip.randomthings.portable_sound_damp: Dampens sounds from Sound Patterns in its inventory while in your inventory.
tooltip.randomthings.iron_dropper: An advanced configurable Dropper. You can change the pickup delay of items dropped, whether the dropper spits the items out "perfectly straight" (Nice for Superlubricent Ice/Stone), whether there are any particles/sound effects & how it reacts to redstone.
tooltip.randomthings.chat_detector: Outputs redstone signal when the owner sends a specific chat message
tooltip.randomthings.global_chat_detecto: Outputs redstone signal when any player sends a specific chat message. Requires ID Card for message consumption.
tooltip.randomthings.id_card: Right-click to bind to yourself. Used by Global Chat Detector for message consumption.
tooltip.randomthings.compressed_slime_bl: Bounces entities upward. Right-click with shovel to compress further (up to 3 levels)
tooltip.randomthings.contact_button: Activate by right-clicking the block it's facing. Provides temporary redstone signal like a button.
tooltip.randomthings.contact_lever: Activate by right-clicking the block it's facing. Toggles redstone signal like a lever.
tooltip.randomthings.diaphanous_block: Changes opacity based on distance to player. Can mimic any block's appearance. Default version has no collision and vanishes when close. Inverted version has collision and appears when close.
tooltip.randomthings.fluid_display: Right-click with fluid container to display fluid texture. Right-click to toggle flowing/still. Shift+right-click to rotate.
tooltip.randomthings.igniter: Ignites blocks in front when powered by redstone. Has 3 modes: Toggle Fire, Ignite, Keep Ignited.
tooltip.randomthings.inventory_tester: Simulates inserting items into adjacent inventories. Emits redstone signal based on success. Redstone behavior can be inverted.
tooltip.randomthings.notification_interf: This block sends configurable toast notifications to you when powered by redstone.
tooltip.randomthings.player_interface: Provides wireless access to your inventory via automation. Different faces access different inventory sections: UP=Armor, DOWN=Hotbar, NORTH=Offhand, Other=Main inventory. Use hoppers, pipes, or other automation blocks to interact with it.
tooltip.randomthings.slime_cube: Makes any chunk act like a slime chunk! When unpowered, allows slimes to spawn at ANY height with increased rate. When powered by redstone, prevents all slime spawning in the chunk.
gui.randomthings.block_destabilizer.lazy: Lazy Mode: Remembers the shape from the last operation for faster subsequent runs
gui.randomthings.block_destabilizer.fuzz: Fuzzy Mode: Only cares about block type, not exact state (e.g., Oak Wood Planks vs Wood Planks)
gui.randomthings.block_destabilizer.rese: Reset: Clears the remembered shape for lazy mode
tooltip.randomthings.iron_dropper.redsto:
Pulse:
Drop one item when receiving
a redstone pulse

Repeat Powered:
Continuously drop items while
powered by redstone

Repeat:
Continuously drop items
regardless of redstone state
tooltip.randomthings.iron_dropper.pickup:
No pickup delay:
Items can be picked up
immediately

5 tick pickup delay:
Items cannot be picked up
for 5 ticks after dropping

20 tick pickup delay:
Items cannot be picked up
for 20 ticks after dropping
tooltip.randomthings.iron_dropper.random:
Exact motion:
Items are ejected with
precise, consistent velocity

Random motion:
Items are ejected with
random velocity and trajectory
tooltip.randomthings.iron_dropper.effect:
No effects:
Silent and invisible dropping

Sound only:
Plays dispensing sound
when dropping items

Particles only:
Shows particle effects
when dropping items

Both sound and particles:
Full audio and visual effects
when dropping items
tooltip.randomthings.light_redirector: Swaps the appearance of blocks placed next to it. Right-click to disable individual sides. §a[Mixin-based visual redirection implemented]
item.runeDust.white.name: White Runic Dust
item.runeDust.orange.name: Orange Runic Dust
item.runeDust.magenta.name: Magenta Runic Dust
item.runeDust.light_blue.name: Light Blue Runic Dust
item.runeDust.yellow.name: Yellow Runic Dust
item.runeDust.lime.name: Lime Runic Dust
item.runeDust.pink.name: Pink Runic Dust
item.runeDust.gray.name: Gray Runic Dust
item.runeDust.light_gray.name: Light Gray Runic Dust
item.runeDust.cyan.name: Cyan Runic Dust
item.runeDust.purple.name: Purple Runic Dust
item.runeDust.blue.name: Blue Runic Dust
item.runeDust.brown.name: Brown Runic Dust
item.runeDust.green.name: Green Runic Dust
item.runeDust.red.name: Red Runic Dust
item.runeDust.black.name: Black Runic Dust
tooltip.randomthings.luminous_block: Bright colored blocks that glow in the dark
tooltip.randomthings.translucent_luminou: Semi-transparent luminous blocks that emit light
tooltip.randomthings.luminous_stained_br: Colored bricks that glow in the dark
tooltip.randomthings.blaze_and_steel: The Fire created by this item burns and spreads significantly faster than vanilla fire
tooltip.randomthings.chunk_analyzer: The Chunk Analyzer allows you to check what blocks a chunk contains. Open its gui and press Scan. After a few seconds you will get the results for the chunk you are in.
tooltip.randomthings.eclipsed_clock: An eclipsed clock allows you to change the time of day. After you hang it on a wall you can (shift) right click it to decrease and increase its target time.
tooltip.randomthings.time_in_a_bottle: Passively collects time while in your inventory. Right-click on blocks to accelerate their tick rate. Can be used with Eclipsed Clocks for instant time manipulation.
item.randomthings.time_in_a_bottle.insuf: Not enough time stored to set the clock!
tooltip.randomthings.ectoplasm: A spiritual essence dropped by spirits. Used to craft spectre ingots.
tooltip.randomthings.ecto_plasm: A spiritual essence. Used to craft various spectre items.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_ingot: A spectral ingot crafted from ectoplasm, gold, and lapis lazuli.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_illuminator: Right-click on the ground to spawn a Spectre Illuminator that will light up the whole chunk. Right-click the entity to retrieve it.
tooltip.randomthings.blackout_powder: Right-click on a block in an illuminated chunk to remove the Spectre Illuminator and retrieve the item.
item.randomthings.stable_ender_pearl.inf: Right click to bind to yourself
item.randomthings.stable_ender_pearl.bou: Will teleport you when dropped (7 seconds)
item.randomthings.ender_bucket.info: An Ender Bucket works mostly like a normal Iron Bucket. However when you right click a non source block it will try to find the closest connected source block and pick that up instead of doing nothing.
item.randomthings.reinforced_ender_bucke: A Reinforced Ender Bucket works like an Ender Bucket but it can hold 10 Buckets of Fluid instead of just one. Also when you hold shift while picking up fluids it won't stop after it finds one source block but will keep going until it is either full or there is no fluid left.
tooltip.randomthings.ender_mailbox: The Ender Mailbox is used to send / receive Ender Letters to / from other players.
tooltip.randomthings.ender_letter: Ender Letters can be used to send other people on a server items and messages.
item.randomthings.ender_letter.no_player: %s does not seem to reside in this world
item.randomthings.ender_letter.no_space: The letter appears to get rejected
block.randomthings.ender_mailbox.owner: You are not the owner of this mailbox
tooltip.randomthings.position_filter: Stores a block position. Right-click a block to set it.
tooltip.randomthings.golden_compass: A Golden Compass can be combined with a position filter to make it point to the position of the Filter.
tooltip.randomthings.item_filter: This filter represents a list of items. Right-click to configure.
tooltip.randomthings.entity_filter: This filter represents an entity type. Right-click on an entity to set it.
tooltip.randomthings.lava_charm: Grants immunity to lava for 10 seconds. Charge bar displays above armor. Recharges when out of lava.
tooltip.randomthings.obsidian_skull: Provides chance-based fire damage immunity. More effective against low fire damage.
tooltip.randomthings.water_walking_boots: Found in Ocean Monuments. Walk on water! (Hold shift to enter water)
tooltip.randomthings.obsidian_water_walk: Combines Obsidian Skull and Water Walking Boots effects
tooltip.randomthings.lava_waders: Combines Obsidian Water Walking Boots and Lava Charm. Walk on both water and lava! Walking on lava surface does not consume charges.
tooltip.randomthings.redstone_activator: Right-click a block to apply a temporary redstone signal. Right-click air to change duration.
tooltip.randomthings.magic_hood: Hides your nameplate and potion particles. Found in dungeons and village blacksmith chests.
tooltip.randomthings.summoning_pendulum: Found in dungeons, the Summoning Pendulum can be used to pickup and move non-hostile entities.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_anchor: Items combined with a Spectre Anchor in a Crafting Table don't leave your inventory when you die.
tooltip.randomthings.superlubricenttinct: A slippery potion ingredient used to craft Super Lubricent Boots
tooltip.randomthings.superlubricent_boot: Wearing Super Lubricent Boots makes you glide over blocks without friction as if you were walking on Super Lubricent Ice. Hold shift to disable the effect.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_key: The Spectre Key grants you access to your own private room in the Spectre Dimension. Hold right-click for 5 seconds to teleport there. Use it again in your room to teleport back.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_core: The core of your Spectre room. Right-click with Ectoplasm to increase room height. Right-click empty-handed to teleport back.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_block: The indestructible walls of your Spectre room. Cannot be broken or moved.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_pickaxe: A Spectre Pickaxe has more durability & enchantability than a diamond pickaxe and also increases the block range of the player holding it by 3 blocks.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_sword: A Spectre Sword has more durability & enchantability than a diamond sword and can also hurt spirits.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_shovel: A Spectre Shovel has more durability & enchantability than a diamond shovel and also increases the block range of the player holding it by 3 blocks.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_axe: A Spectre Axe has more durability & enchantability than a diamond axe and also increases the block range of the player holding it by 3 blocks.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_string: A spectral thread used to craft Spectre Energy devices.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_energy_inje: Receives energy from external sources and stores it in your personal Spectre Energy buffer (1M RF capacity).
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_coil: Transfers energy from your Spectre Energy buffer to adjacent machines.
tooltip.randomthings.spectre_charger: Charges energy-compatible items in your inventory using Spectre Energy. Right-click to toggle on/off.
